SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME, KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO, KEY_2 AS LEGACY_GR_NO FROM KEPTRXL WHERE 1=1 AND DOC_NAME = 'GR' GROUP BY DOC_NAME, KEY_1, KEY_2
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'PSAN' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, 1 AS SEQ, 'C' AS STATUS, ISNULL(B.LEGACY_PO_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, ISNULL(B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, ISNULL(B.BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE, ISNULL(B.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(B.GR_QTY,0) AS GR_QTY, ISNULL(B.GR_AMT,0) AS GR_AMT, ISNULL(B.GR_DATE,' ') AS GR_DATE, ' ' AS LEGACY_PR_NO, ISNULL(B.LEGACY_GR_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_NO, ISNULL(B.LEGACY_GR_SEQ, ' ') AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, ' ' AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, ISNULL(B.RO_QTY,0) AS RO_QTY, ISNULL(B.RO_AMT,0) AS RO_AMT, ISNULL(B.REMARK,' ') AS REMARK FROM KEPTRXL A, KEP_GR_V B WHERE A.DOC_NAME = 'GR' AND A.KEY_1 = B.LEGACY_PO_NO AND A.KEY_2 = B.LEGACY_GR_NO AND A.KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND A.KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'PSAN' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, 0 AS SEQ, 'D' AS STATUS, ISNULL(A.KEY_1,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, ' ' AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, ' ' AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE, 0 AS UNIT_PRICE, 0 AS GR_QTY, 0 AS GR_AMT, ' ' AS GR_DATE, ' ' AS LEGACY_PR_NO, ISNULL(A.KEY_2,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_NO, ' ' AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, ' ' AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, 0 AS RO_QTY, 0 AS RO_AMT, ' ' AS REMARK FROM KEPTRXL A WHERE A.DOC_NAME = 'GR' AND A.KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND A.KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' ) WHERE SEQ = (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(T.LEGACY_GR_NO)=0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM KEP_GR_V T WHERE T.LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND T.LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$') ORDER BY SEQ, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_GR_NO, BUYER_ITEM_NO
DELETE KEPTRXL WHERE 1=1 AND DOC_NAME = 'GR' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$'
